cohort: 87 women undergoing elective caesarean section under spinal anaesthesia at Baghdad Teaching Hospital, Medical city, Iraq from November, 2018 to August, 2019
finding: Preoperative ondansetron in women undergoing caesarean section reduced the risk of spinal anaesthesia-induced hypotension, prevented nausea and vomiting, and decreased the need for vasopressors and metoclopramide.
